content.title: Pedro Pascal confirms dating rumors with Luke Evans' former boyfriend Rafael Olarra?
content.text: Just a few days after being photographed in New York City together, Pedro Pascal and Luke Evans' former boyfriend, Rafael Olarra, have been spotted in Los Angeles. Pedro Pascal and the art director couldn't keep their hands off each other on a stroll this week. Pedro Pascal and Rafael Olarra in Los Angeles The local media reported that Pedro Pascal stepped out in Beverly Hills alongside Olarra on Monday. Photos showed the pair wrapping their arms around each other's waists, with Pascal even leaning in and resting his mouth and chin on Olarra's broad shoulders. Pedro and Rafael chose not to respond when a reporter asked about the nature of their relationship. Pedro Pascal is famously private about his love life. Rafael Olarra with former partner Luke Evans He was romantically linked to Maria Dizzia in 1990s, Game Of Thrones actress Lena Headey in 2014, Robin Tunney in 2015 and Jennifer Aniston in 2025, but none of these relationships were confirmed by the actor. The pair was recently spotted in New York City Rafael Olarra, on the other hand, started dating Luke Evans in 2019 and went public on Instagram in February 2020. The couple split was confirmed in January 2021.
